name: Gilded Poppy Profile
image_vibe: gilded botanical mystery, jewel-toned backstage glamour

prompt.project_info: Create a cinematic profile portrait with a sculptural poppy-petal headpiece and warm analog bokeh.
prompt.main_subject: A clearly adult fictional woman in sharp profile, calm focused expression, natural pores, gold makeup dust, swept-back hair, shoulders covered by opaque pale-gold draping, and an oversized headpiece of burnt-orange and amethyst raw-silk petals with safe antique-gold decorative wire.
prompt.composition_elements: 4:5 tight head-and-shoulders profile, deep shadowed void, distant tungsten bokeh, petals and loose hair moving backward in wind.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: High-contrast chiaroscuro, gold cheekbone highlights, warm jewel-toned bokeh, luxurious surreal opera backstage.
prompt.technical_specs: Hasselblad H6D-100c, 80mm f/1.9, razor-thin focus, Kodak Portra 800 grain and warmth, realistic silk and skin texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Hyper-realistic 4:5 cinematic profile portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman wearing an oversized burnt-orange and amethyst raw-silk poppy-petal headpiece with safe decorative gold wire, opaque pale-gold draping over shoulders, gold makeup dust, dark void, warm tungsten bokeh, wind-blown petals, chiaroscuro, Hasselblad H6D-100c 80mm f/1.9, Kodak Portra 800, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, transparent fabric, sexualized pose, sharp wire contact, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, branded designer replica, watermark, logo, text
